create_summary_scalar: create a TensorBoard scalar summary protobuf from a single numeric tensor value
create_summary_image: create a TensorBoard image summary protobuf from a 3-D uint8 or float32 tensor
create_summary_histogram: create a TensorBoard histogram summary protobuf from a numeric tensor and bin count
create_summary_audio: create a TensorBoard audio summary protobuf from a 1-D int16 audio tensor
create_summary_text: create a TensorBoard text summary protobuf from a UTF-8 string
